verdict.rationale: doola's own Registered Agent product says it lets you 'shield your personal information from public databases by having a separate public-facing address for your business' (doola-docs-20). That service also handles physical mail digitally through the dashboard (doola-docs-19), and business-address guidance is part of the offering (doola-docs-18). Together this covers the core of the story, but the evidence is marketing-level only. missing for 10: detail on which state filings and states accept doola's address (e.g., principal/mailing vs. registered agent address only), first-party docs on how the address is applied in formation or annual-report filings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
